findings.toolContext: _forward/_tryTransfer intentionally use a low-level non-reverting call (audit-07 M-01 fix): a reverting recipient banks to `unclaimable` instead of bricking the pass. The `unclaimable[..] += amount` write after the call is the DESIGNED fallback. Strict equality / unchecked-return here is the documented pattern, not an oversight.
